narrative.intro: Softrams has $59.4M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Softrams won 4 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $14.9M. Softrams' obligations are down 72.6% year over year. Softrams' recent fiscal history shows obligations of $77.7M in FY22, $125M in FY23, $158M in FY24, $207M in FY25, and $217M in FY26, before the current-year total of $59.4M. The Department of Health and Human Services is the largest buyer so far, at $62M. The top markets by NAICS are Custom Computer Programming Services at $35.7M and Computer Systems Design Services at $23.7M. This snapshot focuses on obligations and buyer concentration for the fiscal year to date and does not include award ceilings or future estimates.
